plain: Catalina, an island off the coast of Southern California, is said to be a hotspot for UFOs that move between sea and sky. Michels tells this himself in two episodes, drawing on Undersea UFO Base, a book by the author Preston Dennett. He says "many people think it's a UFO hotspot." In one episode he calls it possibly "the world's biggest hotspot of transmedium water-based UFOs," transmedium meaning craft that pass between air and water. In that episode he also notes that the scientist Townsend Brown spent the end of his life there. A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says it on the show too, without naming Dennett. He calls the Catalina Channel "a hot spot" as part of his argument that the ocean is where such objects gather. If it were true, some of these objects would be based under the water off Los Angeles.
